content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Most creators rely on Stripe and PayPal for payment processing, but these platforms are often unavailable or severely restricted in certain countries, including Nigeria. This is where NOWPayments comes in – a decentralized payment processing solution that allows creators to receive crypto payments directly, without relying on these platforms. By deploying a NOWPayments digital store, you can process transactions instantly, without any delays or fees associated with traditional payment gateways.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can deploy a NOWPayments digital store, you'll need to set up a few essential components. This includes a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages website for hosting, a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script backend for processing payments, and a Supabase or Google Sheets database for storing orders. You'll also need to choose a cryptocurrency for payment processing, such as USDT on Tron or Solana, which offer low transaction fees and fast settlement speeds.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your chosen cryptocurrency and configure your backend logic to process payments automatically. This involves setting up a webhook to receive payment notifications, creating a payment gateway to process transactions, and configuring your delivery pipeline to send products to customers instantly. With NOWPayments, you can process crypto payments and deliver products instantly, without any platform dependencies.
NOWPayments processes USDT payments in under 1 minute, compared to 3-5 days for PayPal.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This involves testing your infrastructure to ensure that everything is working correctly, configuring your payment settings to receive payments in your chosen cryptocurrency, and promoting your digital store to attract customers. With NOWPayments, you can process transactions instantly and receive payments directly, without relying on traditional payment gateways.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.

Set up a webhook to receive payment notifications. Create a payment gateway to process transactions. Configure your delivery pipeline to send products to customers instantly. Test your infrastructure to ensure that everything is working correctly. Configure your payment settings to receive payments in your chosen cryptocurrency. Promote your digital store to attract customers.
